dedupe_keys.name: highway capacity software hcs mctrans center

description: The Highway Capacity Software (HCS), from the McTrans Center, is a macroscopic traffic analysis tool that implements the methods of the Highway Capacity Manual (HCM) without modification, so its results match hand application of the HCM, whose content is overseen by the Transportation Research Board's Committee on Highway Capacity and Quality of Service. Coverage: generic US practice; 12 modules cover operations, safety and capacity of surface streets, freeways, two-lane highways and intersections, including work zones, managed lanes, weather effects and study periods from one peak hour to 24 hours. A new module implements HCM 7th edition Chapter 38 on interactions between arterials and freeways, and map-based segmentation tools exist for freeways and two-lane highways. Format and access: desktop software (HCS 2026), with file compatibility with HSS and links to TSIS-CORSIM, Transyt-7F, Synchro and Excel. Licence and cost: commercial, with a pricing and licensing page. Caveats: deterministic HCM methods, not network simulation. It supports capacity planning and level-of-service checks for links and junctions under reduced capacity, for example work zones or weather. It relates to SIDRA INTERSECTION and PTV Vissim in the catalogue.
